text:
Which statement about alkanes is correct?
A
They contain carbon, hydrogen and oxygen only.
B
They are saturated compounds with only single ionic bonds.
C
The alkanes with longer chain lengths are more volatile.
D
They react with chlorine in a substitution reaction.

options.label: A
options.text: They contain carbon, hydrogen and oxygen only.

options.label: B
options.text: They are saturated compounds with only single ionic bonds.

options.label: C
options.text: The alkanes with longer chain lengths are more volatile.

options.label: D
options.text: They react with chlorine in a substitution reaction.
